verdict.rationale: Honcho ships an official MCP server (hosted or local) that gives MCP-compatible agents persistent memory tools. Its API and SDKs let agents store messages, search, and query representations via `.chat()` and `context()`, so an agent can add to and search memory itself. However, its model relies on background reasoning over ingested messages rather than explicit agent-directed memory edits, and update/delete operations are not evidenced. missing for 10: documented agent-invoked update and delete of memories, an enumerated list of the MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents self-managing memory mid-conversation.
